arabic text: JAB MERE GHAR ME ALAM HAI TO ALAMDAAR BHI HO
english translation text: When a standard stands in my home, may its standard-bearer also be there

arabic text:
Ek jari chaahiye taarike shujaa'at ke liye
Karbala mein mere Shabbir ki nusrat ke liye
Aur na munh se payambar ki hifaazat ke liye
Ya ilaahi mujhe Abbas-sa beta dede
english translation text:
A brave warrior is needed for the history of courage
To support my Shabbir in Karbala
And to protect the Prophet's honour
O God, grant me a son like Abbas

arabic text:
Shukr sad shukr tera shabbar-o-shabbir diye
Betiyaan ki hai ata zainab-o-kulsoom mujhe
Baad iske meri bas ek dua ke badle
Ya ilaahi mujhe Abbas-sa beta dede
english translation text:
A hundred thousand thanks to You for giving me Shabbar and Shabbir
You have also granted me daughters, Zainab and Kulsum
Now, in return for this one prayer of mine
O God, grant me a son like Abbas

arabic text:
Aaina sabr-o-shujaat ka bana na mera
Hu bahu meri hi tasweer ho baccha mera
Usko dekhoon to nazar aaye sarapa mera
Ya ilahi mujhe abbas sa beta dede
english translation text:
Let my child become a mirror of patience and courage
Let him be my very likeness
When I look upon him, may I see my own form embodied
O God, grant me a son like Abbas

arabic text:
Koi be-yar-o-madadgaar agar hojaye
Iltaja behre madad apni zabaan par laye
Mujko awaaz koi de wo madad ko aaye
Ya ilahi mujhe abbas sa beta dede
english translation text:
Whenever someone is left without a helper
And raises a plea for assistance
Whenever anyone calls upon me, may he come to their aid
O God, grant me a son like Abbas

arabic text:
Zindagi jiski guzar jaye alamdaari me
Apne baazoo bhi kata de jo fidakaari me
Sabse aage nazar aaye jo wafadaari me
Ya ilahi mujhe abbas sa beta dede
english translation text:
May his life be spent in bearing the standard
May he even sacrifice his arms in devotion
May he be foremost among all in loyalty
O God, grant me a son like Abbas

arabic text:
Naam uska ho jin hoton pe wahan pyas na ho
Koi umeed na toote koi be aas na ho
Yaad karke use tanhai ka ehsaas na ho
Ya ilahi mujhe abbas sa beta dede
english translation text:
Where his name is spoken, may there be no thirst
May no hope be broken and no one be left without hope
May remembering him remove the feeling of loneliness
O God, grant me a son like Abbas

arabic text:
Mere maalik mere honthhon pe jab aayi ye dua
Meri aankhon mein nazar aane lagi Karbobala
Mera Shabbir musibat mein kharaa hay tanhaa
Ya ilaahi mujhe Abbas-sa beta dede
english translation text:
My Lord, when this prayer came to my lips
Karbala appeared before my eyes
My Shabbir stood alone amid calamity
O God, grant me a son like Abbas

arabic text:
Jab woh karbal mein ho chawbhees pehel ka pyaasa
Har kadam par use isaar ka jazba dena
Aur mere laal ke haathonko salaamat rakhna
Ya ilaahi mujhe Abbas-sa beta dede
english translation text:
When he has endured twenty-four watches of thirst in Karbala
Give him at every step the spirit of self-sacrifice
And keep my son's hands safe and whole
O God, grant me a son like Abbas

arabic text: Ay "kaleem" hogayi maqbool duaa-e-Haidar\nUsko "Mesum" kaha hai Fatema Zehra ne pisar\nArzu ki thi Ali ne jo huzur-e-daawar
english translation text: O "Kaleem", Haider's prayer was accepted\nFatima Zahra called him her son, says "Mesum"\nAli's wish was fulfilled before the Lord
